principles.selective_roles: Do not invoke every discipline mechanically; select only roles relevant to the change.
principles.handoff: Each phase must hand off explicit artifacts/constraints to the next phase.
principles.quality: Worker completion requires objective evidence defined by the selected specialist profile. QA is not complete without test artifacts plus an executed passing test command.
principles.worker_job_size: Use one specialist responsibility per worker job. Backend, data, frontend, QA, documentation and DevOps are separate jobs when independently verifiable.
principles.repair_budget: A failed delegated unit gets at most one specialist repair attempt. The repair owner is chosen from the failed gate/profile rather than blindly reusing the original worker profile.
principles.worker_route_semantics: WORKER is for bounded mechanical/execution-heavy work without substantial Codex pre/post judgment. Codex-owned framing plus worker execution plus Codex review is HYBRID.

sequence: Codex defines bounded handoff and measurable gate
Worker executes exactly one specialist job
Worker must return profile-specific objective evidence
If gate fails: exactly one specialist repair is routed to the role responsible for that failed gate
Codex emits final factory outcome telemetry

preferred_decomposition.data: Persistence/schema/query work as a separate unit when independently verifiable
preferred_decomposition.qa: Test implementation and execution only, after implementation exists
preferred_decomposition.documentation: Documentation only, after behavior is stable
preferred_decomposition.devops-platform: CI/CD/container/IaC as a separate bounded unit
